facts.fact: Algérie360 reports that opening an account on the DGDN's Fadaeldjazair portal requires the 18-digit national identification number (NIN) with birth date and contact details, as a step to verify the user's identity.

DZA.note: Nothing about civil register and ID links.
No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing about an ID number at birth.
Nothing about who operates or owns the ID system.
The NIN is used to open a portal account; no public register is said to be keyed on it.
The NIN is used for portal sign-up, but nothing is said of the ID system itself.

facts.fact: Algérie360 reports that the DGDN's Fadaeldjazair portal runs on a unified central database holding over 27 million documents from 217 land conservations and over 14 million digitised properties.

The DGDN's Fadaeldjazair portal lets users request the land booklet, negative certificate, deed copies and cadastral extracts online, pay by Edahabia or CIB card via SATIM and track the request; some formalities still need an office visit.

DZA.note: Nothing about local government revenue records.
